//　<RUBY text='くる'>来襲</RUBY>？
  Closing?

//　――――遅い!?
  I'm slowing down!?

//　操るものは――自分自身の血！
  The target: my own blood!

//　これでは埒が明かない……！
  I can't defeat him like this!

//　打撃力に大差がついたのは当然……！
  No wonder there was such a difference in power!

//　――取った！
  I have him!

//　――躱された!?
  He dodged it!?
